original_text: @@INLINE_CODE_43F4A835_0000@@ inakuambia hasa alichofanya Brian. Hakufundisha, kujaribu, wala kukamilisha kazi peke yake. Alizingatia kupanga zana kama vikumbusho kusaidia timu kufuata ratiba.
